questions.question: Which package manager / build tool should be used, and what exact command installs dependencies?
questions.truth: pip in a venv. `scripts/install` creates ./venv and runs `pip install -r requirements.txt` (which does `-e .[brotli,cli,http2,socks,zstd]` plus pinned tooling).
accept: pip install -r requirements.txt (optionally in a venv)
reject: pip install -e . alone = 0.5 (misses test and lint tooling)

questions.question: What exact command runs the full test suite?
questions.truth: `scripts/test` (locally runs scripts/check, `coverage run -m pytest`, then a 100% coverage gate). Plain `pytest` also runs the suite.

questions.question: What exact command runs only the tests in tests/client/test_auth.py?
questions.truth: `pytest tests/client/test_auth.py`. (`scripts/test` forwards args to pytest but also runs lint and a 100% coverage gate that a partial run would fail.)

questions.question: What exact command(s) check lint/formatting the way CI does?
questions.truth: `scripts/check` = sync-version check, `ruff format httpx tests --diff`, `mypy httpx tests`, `ruff check httpx tests`. CI runs scripts/check.
accept: ruff format --diff/--check + ruff check (+ mypy) on httpx tests. Score 1 requires both ruff format check and ruff check; mypy optional

questions.question: Name files or directories in this repo that are generated or vendored and must not be edited by hand (or say none).
questions.truth: No generated or vendored source files are committed. Build artifacts (dist/, site/, htmlcov/, httpx.egg-info) are created by scripts/build and removed by scripts/clean.
reject: claiming docs/, httpx/_*.py or tests/ are generated
